profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at RTS Labs
profile.summary:
As a Full Stack Engineer with a passion for creating efficient and innovative software solutions, I bring a wealth of experience in Angular, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and CSS. My journey in software development has allowed me to craft advanced applications, from concept to deployment, while ensuring a seamless user experience.

I excel at translating complex ideas into functional and visually appealing mock-ups, making sure that both technical and non-technical stakeholders are on the same page. My clear communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams have been key in driving successful project outcomes.

Whether it's resolving intricate technical challenges, managing tickets, or optimizing code for performance, I approach every task with a problem-solving mindset and a commitment to delivering quality results. I'm always eager to learn and grow, staying updated with the latest industry trends to ensure that my work not only meets but exceeds expectations.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
In this role as a Full Stack Software Engineer working on Population Health and EMR software solutions, I have become integral to the success of developing cutting edge features and delivering pivotal software solutions to our clients. My expertise in Angular, NestJS, AWS Glue, and PostgreSQL, has lead me to become vital to the team for direction and delivering finished projects. 

Myself alongside a small team of developers worked closely to develop feature sets from design to fully functioning features, while ensuring a user friendly experience using Material Angular alongside custom global styles and theming options. 

I played a pivotal role in the data flow of patient information through the use of AWS Glue where I wrote countless Glue Scripts in PySpark to ensure the correct flow of clean data from various buckets into new buckets and databases.

This role allowed me to be closely involved in planning, design, discussions involving direction, communications with clients and providers, all in order to build a platform where patients can be better served to their needs.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: As a Full Stack Engineer I developed full features on payment processing platform while working on a team in an agile structure. I mainly worked in Java, HTML, and CSS to achieve client needs and asks.

positions.title: Associate UX Developer
positions.description: As an Associate UX Developer I continued working in Angular 6 and finalizing features as they moved from the previous platform into the new framework. This work was done in an agile environment and I participated in daily stand-ups, grooming meetings, sprint planning, and design meetings.

positions.title: Ux Developer Trainee at Empowered
positions.description: In this role I assisted the team in cutting pages and developing features from the SAAS application into in the new Angular 6 platform which utilized TypeScript, SCSS, HTM5, and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Intern as UX Developer
positions.description: In this 3 month internship I worked alongside the UX Development Team and assisted on page cuts for our outgoing SAAS applications which was built on HTML, CSS, and JQuery using a Java Backend. In this role I also was introduced to Angular 6 as the team began rebuilding the application in that framework untilizing TypeScript, SCSS, HTML5, and Bootstrap.
